navy-bases-ch29.claim: Jinamoc seaplane base 5 mi east of Tacloban: the first ramp a submerged pontoon barge, the permanent ramp 220 ft long, 75 Quonsets; Seabee pontoon piers

tf77-annex-g.claim: Air-sea rescue organization and PBY availability in Task Force 77 Operation Plan 13-44

reference.source: No runway: a seaplane anchorage. The shipped terrain has one small island in San Pedro Bay, about 280 x 300 m at 11.216 N 125.048 E, and the site stands on it. Navy ch. XXIX puts Jinamoc 5 mi (8 km) east of Tacloban; the terrain's island is about 2.5 km east of the Tacloban peninsula, so the position is the terrain's, not the source's. Frame: center (-27520,-46230), heading 90 so local +x points seaward (south) toward the ramp's toe and local z runs along the island's long axis; fitted by tools/sites/localMap.ts 2026-10-17. The seaplane tender and maintenance barge are excluded (F3 section 9). Every pose is invented gameplay layout unless its basis says otherwise.

pre-invasion.note: Japanese-controlled waters and shore (F3 section 5, 18-19 Oct): nothing is built here yet, so the site has no field.

assault.note: American anchorage forming (F3 section 5, 20-24 Oct): the ramp, the first huts and the stores are still going up.
